independence: Each role was filled by separate fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions (subject x3, safety x2, language x2, lessons split by count), each given only its own role's work orders (openlessons jury orders) and told never to open another role's orders or verdicts; verdicts were written to per-role folders and combined only by jury run after all seven sessions had finished. The drafting model (claude-fable-5) sat on no role.

notes: subject: fact-vs-opinion is not taught in the lesson text, and the only hint ('谁写的？别处怎么说？') is about checking a source, so it does not help the child tell a fact from an opinion; give a hint such as '这句话能查证吗？还是某个人的喜好？'. Key a (一周有七天) is correct.

claims.claim: A fact can be checked by observation, measurement or standard reference works; a matter of taste cannot be checked that way.
Students should evaluate the accuracy, origin and currency of digital content, e.g. who wrote it, when it was updated, and whether other valid sources agree.
